app.name: Måltidsplanlegger
app.tagline: High-protein meals for the whole family

week.title: Week plan
week.description: Here the app creates a high-protein week plan for the whole family, tailored to each adult's protein target.

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.description: Here the app builds the shopping list automatically from the week plan.

pantry.title: At home
pantry.description: Here you keep track of what you have at home and what has run out.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.description: Here you find all recipes, with search, filters and favourites.

install.cardTitle: Add the app to your home screen
install.cardText: It then opens like a regular app, straight from your phone.
install.installed: The app is installed on this device.
install.installedToast: The app was added to your home screen
install.promptText: Tap “Install” to add the app to your home screen.
install.iosTitle: How to do it on iPhone and iPad
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button (square with an arrow pointing up) in the browser.
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosStep3: Tap “Add” in the top right corner.
install.manualStep2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.manualNote: Don't see the option? Then this browser doesn't support installing. Try Chrome, Edge or Samsung Internet, or Safari on iPhone.
